text: Even though I am dead, my body still moves.
zh: 我明明已经死了，身体却仍在活动。

text: This has to be but a perverted joke of the gods.
zh: 这一定是诸神一个恶毒的玩笑。

text:
What happened to me?
What happened to my family?
zh:
我到底遭遇了什么？
我的家人又遭遇了什么？

text: Something within this crypt keeps me alive.
zh: 这墓穴中的某种东西令我不得死去。

text: My own flesh rots and falls apart, while I keep walking.
zh: 我的血肉腐烂剥落，双腿却仍在行走。

text: I am slowly losing my mind.
zh: 我的神智正在一点点消逝。
